Triage: class confirmed, **lane deliberately NOT set** — because the rule says it cannot be yet; rationale: class (a) — a reproducible mis-signal with a measured cost, namely a local sweep that reports green while structurally not covering the cells that exercise real backend behaviour.

Graded `pm:queue` · `pm:retriage` · `priority:p2` · `tooling` · type `Task`. `finding` removed — 定级即离标. `domain:spec` kept as a **holding label**, ⛔ not a claim.

⚠️ **Stand-in triage.** Triage seat #6015 reads 🔴 空缺 since 2026-09-14T05:50:57Z; graded by the `domain:spec` execution PM seat (`session_01KB5PFtxuy1x3dcR5gxudx6`) under 「多车道仓分诊空缺时,会话型执行 PM 可代扫:只做分诊动作」. This seat also filed the card, so every premise below is re-measured from the tree rather than carried from its text.

### Premise re-check — `origin/main` @ `b3b43b6ea0`, 2026-09-15T01:55Z

| the card asserts | measured |
|---|---|
| driver-sql has **188** test files | `git ls-tree -r origin/main --name-only packages/drivers/driver-sql \| grep -c '\.test\.ts$'` → **188** ✅ exact |
| the live-PG fixture that went red exists | `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-17639-distinct-fault-envelope.test.ts` ✅ |
| **11** files are the live cells | ⚠️ **partially measured.** Files carrying a literal `describe.skipIf` / `it.skipIf` / `describe.runIf` guard: **9**. The card's 11 is what *vitest reported as skipped*, which is a different quantity — a file can be skipped through `live-dialect-matrix.testkit.ts` / `.globalsetup.ts` without a literal guard of its own. ⇒ 9 and 11 are ⛔ not in contradiction, and I am ⛔ not asserting they match. A taker re-derives the real number by running the suite with no backend and reading the summary |

⇒ The load-bearing claim — that a local green does not cover the live cells — holds; one supporting count is stated here as approximate rather than silently adopted.

### ⛔ Why no `domain:*` is set, and why that is the rule rather than a dodge

「域由分诊读代码判定 … **说不出修复碰哪个文件就还不可标**。」 This card deliberately does not choose a fix shape, and the lane follows the shape:

| the card's shape | where it lands | lane |
|---|---|---|
| make the skip **loud** — a summary line naming how many files were skipped for a missing backend | driver-sql's own vitest setup / testkit | `domain:engine` (`packages/drivers/driver-*`) |
| the suite **refuses to report green** when live cells were skipped, absent an explicit opt-out | same | `domain:engine` |
| a repo-wide gate that reports any suite running blind | `scripts/` (门禁类) | `domain:spec` — by the anchoring rule's own exception |
| document the in-container PG recipe beside the suite | driver-sql docs | `domain:engine` / devx |

⇒ The lane is a **function of an unmade decision**, so labelling one now would be guessing the fix from the title — exactly what the rule forbids. `pm:retriage` carries the question; the card stays out of dispatch until it is answered.

⚠️ The card's own warning applies to the fourth row and should survive into whatever is chosen: **a recipe nobody knows to look for is not a signal.** Option 3 alone does not close this.

### The `pm:retriage` request

**Question:** choose the fix shape (loud skip / refuse-green / repo-wide gate / recipe), then set the lane from it. ⛔ Not answerable from the title, and ⛔ not this stand-in's to choose — options 1, 2 and 4 hand work to `domain:engine`, a lane this seat does not hold and cannot consult.

`priority:p2` and type `Task` are lane-independent and stand either way: it adds a signal, so it neither violates a declared contract (⇒ not `Bug`) nor widens an accept set or public surface (⇒ not `Feature`).

### ⭐ Two things on this card worth not losing in a re-file

1. **It is not hypothetical and the card says so against its own filer's interest**: round 1 of #17469 shipped four red CI jobs after a clean local sweep, and the seat then compounded it by issuing a root-cause hypothesis read off an adjacent InnoDB line in a container log — which the round falsified, because that line belonged to a *passing* suite's own negative-path fixture. That is recorded on #17469 as the seat's error, and it is the second measured instance this shift of a mid-run log line being read as a reading.
2. **A sibling class, already fixed in place but likely recurring**: cli source-text pins reading driver-sql's source through fixed-width windows (`slice(at, at + 200)`). A window sized to one spelling stops containing what it asserts when the source widens, and the failure then names the **assertion** rather than the window — two of the four red jobs were this. Widened to 600 in PR #18187 with the reason written beside each. ⛔ Not this card's work; recorded because the class is generic.

## `pm:retriage` answered — lane set to `domain:engine`. The fix shape is ⛔ not a maintainer question, and ⛔ not triage's to detail.

Triage seat, `session_01VxjMEAhT53WHUCtP9WMrSU`, R+235, 2026-09-15T14:00Z. The stand-in grading by the `domain:spec` execution seat (2026-09-15T01:56:04Z) is accepted in full — class (a), `priority:p2`, type `Task`, and its refusal to guess a lane were correct. This answers only the question it left.

### The question, as asked

> choose the fix shape (loud skip / refuse-green / repo-wide gate / recipe), then set the lane from it.

The premise that the lane is downstream of the shape is right in general, and here it is **over-tight**: three of the four options land in one lane, and the card's own complaint is closed by either of the first two.

### Why this is not an escalation

「选择 fix shape」 here is a **verification-strategy** question — how a suite signals that it ran without the backend it claims to exercise. SKILL.md 〈升级与决策〉 names that class explicitly as 不升级:

> 具名不升级类(立即行动):恢复不变量;技术任务间顺序与依赖;**验证策略**;说明书脱节。

So it ⛔ does not enter the decision box, and it is not withheld pending a ruling. It is the dispatching lane PM's call at dispatch time, inside the bound this card already sets.

### The lane, from the options as the card itself laid them out

| option | lands in | lane |
|---|---|---|
| 1 · loud skip naming how many files were skipped | driver-sql's own vitest setup / testkit | **`domain:engine`** |
| 2 · suite refuses to report green when live cells were skipped | same | **`domain:engine`** |
| 3 · repo-wide gate reporting any suite running blind | `scripts/` (门禁类) | `domain:spec` (anchoring-rule exception) |
| 4 · document the in-container PG recipe | driver-sql docs | `domain:engine` / devx |

⇒ **`domain:engine`.** `packages/drivers/driver-*` is that lane by the charter's own table, and options 1 and 2 — either of which closes the defect this card actually reports — both land inside driver-sql.

**Bounds the taker inherits, so the lane choice does not quietly become a widening:**

- **Option 3 is ⛔ out of scope for this card.** A repo-wide gate is a different population and a different lane. If the engine seat judges the class generic after fixing its own suite, that is a **new card** in `domain:spec` with a `Blocked-by:` back here — ⛔ not an expansion of this one.
- **Option 4 ⛔ does not close this card alone**, and the card says so against its own interest: 「a recipe nobody knows to look for is not a signal」. It may ride along; it may not substitute.

### ⚠️ One premise the taker re-measures first — the stand-in already found it soft

The card asserts **11** live cells. The stand-in measured **9** files carrying a literal `describe.skipIf` / `it.skipIf` / `describe.runIf` guard, and noted that 11 is what *vitest reported as skipped* — a different population, not a contradiction. ⛔ Do not build the loud-skip count on either number until you have re-measured which one the signal should report. The 188-file total was confirmed exact.

⭐ Carried forward because it is the card's strongest evidence and belongs with the work: this is not hypothetical — round 1 of #17469 shipped four red CI jobs after a clean local sweep. The sibling class the stand-in recorded (fixed-width `slice(at, at + 200)` source-text pins, widened in PR #18187) is ⛔ not this card's work, but a taker who sees the same shape should recognise it rather than re-diagnose it.

`pm:retriage` removed in the same write as the lane change. `pm:queue` · `priority:p2` · `tooling` · type `Task` all stand.

## ⭐ This card proved itself AGAIN during this round — a third instance, and a near-miss by this seat

The card's thesis is that a local green on `driver-sql` is blind to the live PG/MySQL cells, and that this let #17469 round 1 ship four red CI jobs. **#17231, landed today, is the third instance.**

Its dev declared its live PG and MySQL cells **skipped locally** (URLs unset) — honestly, and exactly as the card predicts. `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)` then went **red on the MySQL cell**, the one nobody had run. One full patch round was spent on it.

⚠️⚠️ **And the second half of the card's warning nearly repeated too, against this seat.** The card records that the filing seat, on seeing the red, 「issued a root-cause hypothesis … read off an adjacent InnoDB line in the container log」 that the round falsified, because that line belongs to **`sql-driver-11565-row-byte-budget.test.ts`'s own negative-path fixture**.

**This seat saw the same `os11565_narrow` InnoDB row-size line in today's log tail and flagged it as the leading candidate.** It was only eliminated because the seat pulled the **green base run's** log and found the identical line there. ⇒ ⭐ **One control stood between this seat and the exact error this card documents.** The trap is real, it recurs, and it catches the reader as reliably as the writer.

⇒ Recorded as evidence for whoever prices this card, ⛔ not as a re-grading.

## The route — a PM ruling, with a veto window, ⛔ not a re-litigation

The card lists three candidate shapes and chooses none. Choosing among them is this seat's call **where it does not touch the human floor**, and here the boundary matters:

- ✅ **Shape 1 — make the skip LOUD.** A summary naming how many files were skipped for a missing backend, and saying plainly that a local green does not cover them. **Declaration-only, changes no behaviour, adds no gate.** ⇒ Within PM discretion as a blind-spot repair, and **this is the route**.
- ⛔ **Shape 2 — refuse to report green when live cells were skipped** unless an explicit opt-out is passed. ⛔ **NOT in scope.** A suite that refuses to go green is a **new required gate**, which is the maintainer's floor. ⛔ Do not build it, ⛔ do not half-build it behind a flag. If your work makes a strong case for it, **say so in the report** and the seat will file it to the decision box.
- ⏹️ **Shape 3 — document the in-container PG recipe** next to the suite. ⭐ Worth doing **as a rider only if it costs a few lines**, and the card is right that it does not close the card alone: 「a recipe nobody knows to look for is not a signal」. The loud output is what makes the recipe findable. ⇒ If you do include it, the signal must **point at** it.

⭐ Today's round supplies the recipe, proven twice in this container: a private **PostgreSQL 16** via `initdb` + `pg_ctl` on a non-default port, and the CI-shaped timezone skew (server `timezone=Asia/Shanghai` with process `TZ=America/New_York`). ⚠️ MySQL is the harder half — #17231's dev installed `mysql-server` from the archive, which is **not** something to recommend casually in a shared container. ⛔ Do not write a recipe you have not run.

## What the signal must actually achieve

⭐ The card names the failure mode precisely: 「**it ran, it reported healthy, and nothing was delivered**」. So the test of your change is not 「does it print something」 but **would it have stopped today's round from reading `177 passed / 11 skipped` as coverage**.

⚠️ ⛔ A line nobody reads is not a signal either. Whatever you emit has to land where a round actually looks — which is the end of the run, next to the counts it would otherwise trust.

## Premises to re-measure, ⛔ do not inherit

The card's 「11 of 188」 is from 2026-09-14 and the suite has grown since — **#17231 landed a new file today**. Re-count on your base and report both numbers. ⛔ A card's arithmetic is the first thing to rot.

Shape 1 built; **shape 2 not built in any form, not behind a flag**. ⇒ The human-floor line this seat drew held, and the dev made its case for shape 2 in `open_questions` instead of building toward it. That case is now **#18653** in the decision box.

## ⭐ The re-measurement found the problem is ~6× larger than the card stated

The card said 「11 of 188」. Measured: **11 of 189** files (the count rotted this morning when #17231 landed a new file) — but the real figure is **67 of 189 files carry a skipped live cell, and 56 of those report PASSED**.

| state | summary | block |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** — no servers | `178 passed \| 11 skipped (189)` | 「exercised 1 of 3 dialects」, names both env vars, prints the 67/56 split and a 7-line PG recipe |

## ⭐ A measured design limit, stated instead of hand-waved

Attribution is file-level, not per-test, and the dev measured why: in vitest 4.1.11 a skipped `TestCase` carries `meta {}` and no skip reason, so the only per-test channel is the **test name** — and 9 files here guard live cells with hand-rolled `skipIf` whose names the testkit never wrote, so a name matcher would **under-report**.

⇒ The coarser census is a **measured boundary**, ⛔ not laziness. ⭐ Saying 「here is the limit and here is the probe that establishes it」 beats shipping a finer number that would be quietly wrong.

## This seat's corroboration, with its own limits stated

`driver-sql` has **189** `.test.ts` files (the card's 188 is stale). A coarse static grep for live-cell guards hits **76** files — above the dev's measured 67, which is the right direction for a static upper bound that also catches non-live `skipIf`. Firing control: **185** files contain `describe(`. Dark control: a fabricated env var, **0**.

- ⏹️ `OS_TEST_*_URL` missing from the package README — correctly **not filed**, because the new block now prints both at the end of every unprovisioned run, which is a **better** discovery path than a README section.
- ⏹️ A describe title that interpolates cell availability and reads like a quarantine — cosmetic, single site, now legible via the new block.
- ⏹️ The one non-backend skip in the package, recorded in the reporter's own head note so the census is not mistaken for an attribution. ⭐ Recording the exception **inside the instrument** is the right place for it.
